name: errand
description: Send a real person to a place in Seoul to check, photograph, verify, queue, or pick something up, and get GPS- and time-verified evidence back.

api_key.title: Errand API key
api_key.description: Starts with er_live_. Get one free at https://errand.be — enter an email, type the 6-digit code, and the key is shown once. Add a prepaid balance at https://errand.be/dashboard before dispatching.
